question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**groom**" means to prepare someone for a particular activity or role. (तैयार करना)
 
• In the context of student clubs, it is where students find time to prepare or groom themselves for their future.
 
• The other options: **"control," "clean," and "interrupt" do not fit the context as appropriately.**

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *It is the only place where students find time to groom__ themselves for their future.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Control (नियंत्रण)**: means to determine the behavior or supervise the running of something.
 
• **Clean (साफ़ करना)**: means to make something free from dirt or mess.
 
• **Interrupt (विचलित करना)**: means to stop the continuous progress of an activity or process.
